page.overview:
What is Tom Riddle Sr?

Tom Riddle Senior (1905 – August 1943) was an affluent English Muggle who lived in the village of Little Hangleton in England. He was the son of wealthy Muggles Thomas and Mary Riddle, who raised him to be snobbish and rude.

Tom was magically coerced into marrying Merope Gaunt, most likely by means of a Love potion, although the Imperius Curse is another possibility. If it was the former, it was theorised that Merope stopped giving him the potion after some time because she thought that he would start loving her naturally, at least for their unborn baby. But the desired did not happen. He left her once she stopped bewitching him, sometime before the birth of their son, Tom Marvolo Riddle, who would grow to become the Dark wizard Lord Voldemort. Tom Riddle Senior was very handsome and this was what attracted Merope Gaunt.

The latter's sixteen-year-old son, Tom Marvolo Riddle, later murdered him and his grandparents in cold blood. This was in retaliation for what Tom Marvolo Riddle saw as his father's abandonment of his family. While neither his death nor that of his parents was notable among Muggles, as few Little Hangleton residents grieved, it would be pivotal in Wizarding history. His murder was used to make his father-in-law's ring into a Horcrux. In 1995, his last remaining bone helped his son return to full power.

Born to Thomas and Mary Riddle in 1905, Tom Riddle Senior lived in a luxurious manor house not far from a run-down cottage that was home to the Gaunts, a wizarding family descended from Salazar Slytherin and Cadmus Peverell, outside the Muggle village of Little Hangleton. Merope Gaunt, who led a miserable life of poverty and abuse at the hands of her father and brother, became infatuated with Tom, watching him ride by on his horse, sometimes in the company of a woman named Cecilia, who Tom was courting.
